name: Durka Simulator
source:
Durka Simulator is a visual novel where adventures and mysteries are waiting for you.
You as the main player are being sought to take away your power.
You and mysterious one must not let them catch you!
With you will always be your friends lemur Zina, Mysterious One and Larry

Your objective is to not get caught by medics!
Will you be able to beat them?

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1450150/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Durka Simulator》是一款视觉小说，其中的冒险和神秘正在等待着你。
你作为主要玩家正在寻求夺走你的权力。
你和神秘人一定不能让他们抓住你！
狐猴吉娜、神秘人和拉里将永远陪伴着你

你的目标是不被医务人员抓住！
你能打败他们吗？

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1450150/]Steam[/url]]
